name: LM4562 / LME49720 / LME49710 / LME49740
tagline: National's 2006–07 audio op-amp: 2.7 nV/√Hz, 0.00003% THD+N; the standard NE5532 upgrade, TO-99 cans collectable.

lineage.note: LM4562 Aug 2006 (DS201572), LME49710 Nov 2006, LME49740 Feb 2007; LME49720 rename Mar 2007. Greenock-fabbed.
TI-format reissues 2013–2016; 2015 EOL scare; PCN 20180308002 moved wafers Greenock→Dallas DL-LIN; TO-99 lifebuy c.2017.

part_numbers.note: Original name (Aug 2006); same die as LME49720. TI kept LM4562MAX in production.
Sources conflict on active vs lifebuy. Fakes documented (JE6LVE; diyAudio 266368).
Renamed LM4562; datasheet SNAS393 from March 2007. Covered by PCN 20180308002.
On c.2015 EOL list (diyAudio 280990), later reported active. Fake documented (diyAudio 386852).
Most prized variant; lifebuy c.2017, presumed obsolete. Can reportedly stresses the die less.
Single, 2.5 nV/√Hz; datasheet SNAS376 (Nov 2006). EOL under PDN 20170721000C.
EOL under PDN 20170721000C after a reversed 2015 EOL notice (E2E 457875).
Quad, 2.7 nV/√Hz; datasheet SNAS377 (Feb 2007). On c.2015 EOL list.

key_specs.value: ±2.5 V to ±17 V; abs max 36 V
23 mA guaranteed; swing within 2.5 V of rails
Bipolar, differential input diodes; Aol 140 dB typ
key_specs.condition: input CM within 2 V of rails

reputation.summary: The default 'better than NE5532' upgrade, with distortion near test-equipment limits; NwAvGuy's 2011 measurements are often cited for it. Reportedly stock or socketed in Asus Xonar and Creative cards and common in Chinese DACs. Listeners call it neutral, clear and detailed, sometimes clinical. LM4562 vs LME49720 'voicing' is folklore: TI says same silicon.
typical_uses: NE5532/4580 replacement in CD players, DACs, sound cards
Pro-audio line stages; SDR audio/IQ stages
caveats: 55 MHz GBW: may oscillate in some sockets and layouts; needs good local decoupling.
Max supply ±17 V (36 V abs max); use LME49860 for ±18–22 V rails.
Input protection diodes (E2E 337068); 1/f noise (E2E 415907), start-up (PADF 641), RF susceptibility (ASR 10687) discussed.
Made in TI Dallas, not Greenock, since 2018 under the same part number; old-vs-new claims unverified.
Marketplace DIP and TO-99 stock is often fake; prices differ between identical LM4562 and LME49720.

counterfeit_notes: Marketplace DIP and TO-99 parts are often fake: LME49710 (tinytransistors, 2022-09-24), LME49720NA (diyAudio 386852), LM4562NA (diyAudio 266368; JE6LVE measured ~0.001% vs 0.0006% THD). Buy SOIC from authorised distributors; check THD, 12 mA supply current, era-correct logo. 'JR' lots = Greenock.

part_numbers_affected: LM4562 (SOIC MA/MAX confirmed; full PCN list not seen)
LME49720 (SOIC MA/MAX confirmed; full PCN list not seen)
silicon_changes.identification: Part number and marking unchanged; only lot/date code shows the fab. Forum claims: 2019+ date codes are Dallas; 'JR' lots are Greenock-fab, Malaysia-assembled.
silicon_changes.summary: PCN 20180308002, 'Transfer of select VIP3 devices from GFAB to DFAB (DL-LIN) Wafer Fab site', moved LM4562/LME49720 wafers from closing TI Greenock to TI Dallas, same VIP3 process. First ship 2018-06-09; reissued as -001 (2018-03-26, first ship 2018-09-26). Stock reached distribution early 2019. No die redesign documented.

spec_deltas.after: VIP3 (same process family, per the PCN title)
200 mm / 8-inch per diyAudio posters and one search summary of the PCN. However, TI's LM6172 PCN 20241217001.1 describes DL-LIN VIP3 as a 150 mm line, so this is not confirmed.
No datasheet revision tied to the PCN was found, so there is no published spec delta.

silicon_changes.audio_impact: No spec change or old-vs-new data. One diyAudio report: 2019+ parts lack popcorn noise seen in some earlier LM4562 lots (anecdotal).
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low: same part, pinout, process family and limits; unspecified noise or RF behaviour could shift.
silicon_changes.verification: PCN title and -001 date confirmed; wafer size conflicts. Earlier SFAB-to-RFAB die-shrink claim was an NE5532-PCN mix-up.

part_numbers_affected: LME49720HA (TO-99 metal can; the TI E2E reply spells it 'LME49270')
silicon_changes.identification: Discontinuance, not silicon. All LME49710 packages and LM4562/LME49720 TO-99 are EOL; SOIC/PDIP returned to Active after the fab transfer. Such parts today are old stock or fakes.
silicon_changes.summary: TI discontinued GFAB-sourced devices as Greenock closed (PDN 20170721000C; last order 2018-08-07, last ship 2019-02-07): LME49710HA/MAX/NA, replaced by OPA1611AID/AIDR. LM4562/LME49720 TO-99 went lifebuy c.2015–2017. Around 2025-01 stock tightened; one LME49720 1k price rose GBP 1.48→3.78, with no notice found.
silicon_changes.audio_impact: None to the silicon; post-EOL buyers get remaining stock or possible fakes.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low: discontinuance only; the OPA1611 substitute differs in input structure, noise and bias.
silicon_changes.verification: PDN contents confirmed; TI E2E reply (spelled 'LME49270') confirmed. No 2025 notice found.

claims_confirmed: TI PCN 20180308002 covers the LM4562/LME49720 wafer-fab transfer (https://mm.digikey.com/Volume0/opasdata/d220001/medias/docus/754/PCN20180308002.pdf ; https://www.mouser.com/PCN/Texas_Instruments_PCN20180308002_2018032619395130.pdf ; https://e2e.ti.com/support/audio-group/audio/f/audio-forum/565489/lm4562-lm4562-lme49720---eol-really-why).
diyAudio thread 'LM4562 (aka LME49720) Fab moved from GB to US' exists (https://www.diyaudio.com/forums/parts/326045-lm4562-aka-lme49720-fab-moved-gb.html).
'JR' lots = Greenock fab, Malaysia assembly; LM4562 = LME49720 apart from order number and marking (https://www.diyaudio.com/community/threads/lme49720-vs-lm4562.107344/page-7).
SNAS393D (March 2007, revised November 2016) is the current LME49720 datasheet (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/lme49720.pdf).
SNAS326K revised December 2013; TI lit link (https://www.ti.com/lit/pdf/snas326).
LME49720: ±2.5 to ±17 V, 0.00003% THD+N, 2.7 nV/√Hz, ±20 V/µs (https://www.mouser.com/datasheet/2/405/snas393c-316845.pdf).

TI E2E c.2017: LME49710 Active on three packages, LM4562 TO-99 lifebuy, LM4562MAX still produced (https://e2e.ti.com/support/audio-group/audio/f/audio-forum/565489/lm4562-lm4562-lme49720---eol-really-why).
LME49740 DIP discontinued; LME49720NA/LME49740MA on a c.2015 TI EOL list (https://www.diyaudio.com/community/threads/ti-to-discontinue-many-ics.280990/).
LME49720 reported Active at product level (https://www.ti.com/product/LME49720).
refuted_claims: 'No PCN found' is wrong: TI PCN 20180308002 (March 2018) moved LM4562/LME49720 wafer fabrication (DigiKey and Mouser PCN copies, TI E2E 565489).
'SFAB to RFAB, 150 mm to 300 mm' is unsupported; sources give 150 mm (6-inch) to 200 mm (8-inch), itself unconfirmed.
SFAB-to-RFAB die-shrink under PCN 20180308002 is refuted: the PCN is 'GFAB to DFAB (DL-LIN)'. That wording matches NE5532-family PCN 20231114002.1 (Hackaday, June 2026).
Source https://mouser.com/PCN/Texas_Instruments_PCN20180308002_20180309162016256[1].pdf dropped: mangled download filename; valid Mouser -001 and DigiKey copies kept.
Source https://e2e.ti.com/support/audio-group/audio/f/audio-forum/1255412/lm4562-lm4562-oscillation dropped: an application-oscillation thread, not a silicon change.
corrections: Added silicon change for PCN 20180308002. Source fab uncertain (E2E: SFAB Sherman; diyAudio: GB/Greenock). Identification by lot/date code; 'JR' = Greenock fab, Malaysia assembly.
Raised to high confidence (headers seen): SNAS326J Octopart, SNAS393B Mouser, SNAS393D symlink, SNAS376C Mouser, SNAS376B capi-gear, National LME49710 pken.net, SNAS377B Mouser.
Added copies: Mouser snas393c-316845.pdf, ti.com/lit/pdf/snas326, Octopart 10848032, alldatasheet 611621 and 841141, PartsConnexion, Qobuz LM4562. Product pages and PCN seeds added.

Statuses: LME49710 Active c.2017 (later EOL); LM4562 TO-99 lifebuy; LME49740 DIP discontinued; LME49740MA/LME49720NA on c.2015 EOL list; LME49720 Active.
LME49720 key specs (±2.5 to ±17 V, 0.00003%, 2.7 nV/√Hz, ±20 V/µs) confirmed from SNAS393.
The 2015 EOL reversal is explained by the move to a new wafer fab (PCN 20180308002).
